assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite atlas, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Reference image is only for Hanekawa Tsubasa identity, pixel palette, outfit and chibi proportions; make NEW distinct animation poses. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells, no gaps or grid lines, no labels, no text, no watermark, no scenery, no shadows or particles outside characters. 16 sprites. Each cell contains ONE complete small full-body character with all hair and feet inside its own cell and consistent scale. True crisp low-resolution 64x64 game pixel art per cell, hard-edged pixel clusters, about 24 colors, no anti-aliasing. Character about 46 pixels tall inside a 64px cell, feet on same baseline at y=58, generous transparent margins, centered at x=32. High consistency of shape and clothing across the 16 frames. Daytime Hanekawa: dark brown hair, round glasses, small braid with yellow tie, modest dusty pink blouse, black bow, pleated dark skirt, dark stockings and brown shoes, cheerful thoughtful expression. This is a FOUR DIRECTION WALK atlas. CRITICAL: genuine side and back views, NOT front-facing characters sliding sideways. Row 1 (top): all FOUR sprites WALKING RIGHT, face and nose pointing screen-right, body in 3/4 right side profile, hair mass and braid trail toward screen-left; four different leg-contact/passing poses and subtle synchronized trailing hair swing. Row 2: all FOUR sprites WALKING LEFT, face and nose screen-left, body 3/4 left side profile, hair mass and braid trail toward screen-right, four matching walk phases. These should clearly turn the entire character, never keep front-facing bangs or hair silhouette. Row 3: all FOUR sprites walking AWAY/UP, full BACK of head and outfit with no eyes or face, braid visible from behind, four foot phases. Row 4: all FOUR sprites walking TOWARD viewer/DOWN, FRONT view with glasses and eyes, alternating stepping foot and arms. Face direction must be unambiguous in each row. Every row is a seamless 4-frame loop. Keep the same character and avoid doll-like head-only pivots.
